$comment: Work-package registry for plan 8261645 (Parallel convergence tracks).
Decomposition-only: this file declares ownership, dependencies, evidence
outputs and non-authoritative stop conditions. It never mutates state.

C.name: Interaction ontology, Brainfood slices, Aegis/Wind consumption

D.name: Resolution, Keychains bindings, KG projection contract

evidence_slot_schema.observed: command or file path + result summary

packages.title: Twin-port continuity register
evidence_outputs: register citing ports.yaml + PORT-MAP.md rows
observed local port-scan state with timestamp
packages.stop_condition: register published; ports.yaml, generated PORT-MAP regions and service processes untouched
packages.authority_boundary: may not edit the port registry, start/stop a twin, or ratify a port

packages.title: Canary promotion ladder continuity
evidence_outputs: canary-diff record referenced from moleculer/PORT-MAP.md status column
packages.stop_condition: ladder published as references; cutover decisions remain with the named plans and the reviewer
packages.authority_boundary: no merge, no cutover, no traffic shift

packages.title: Bounded Night-Shift rehearsal harness
evidence_outputs: rehearsal transcript (planner -> builder -> critic -> reviewer) against an isolated test DB
bound proof: same-file batching and <=5 work requests per cycle
receipt-isolation proof (test DB, live conduit DB never contacted)
packages.stop_condition: rehearsal recorded as non-authoritative evidence; no live receipt, plan transition or merge produced
packages.rollback: drop the rehearsal database and branch; nothing to retract
packages.authority_boundary: may not write to the live conduit DB, merge, or attest

packages.title: Rehearsal receipt and rollback proof
evidence_outputs: receipt-chain snapshot from the isolated rehearsal store
rollback demonstration (unblock/ticket release or branch revert) with the observed command
packages.stop_condition: receipt and rollback slots filled or explicitly reported unfilled; review judgement stops before merge authority
packages.rollback: delete the rehearsal store snapshot copy

packages.title: Versioned interaction vocabulary v1
evidence_outputs: frozen vocabulary_version 1.0.0
per-entry provenance (source path + declared/observed marker)
packages.stop_condition: vocabulary frozen; extension requires a version bump, never an in-place edit
packages.rollback: supersede with a new version file
packages.authority_boundary: describes actors/roles/states/transitions/rules/invariants/context; creates no role, rule or state

packages.title: Bounded Brainfood slice contract
evidence_outputs: slice identity + source references + fingerprints
valid/recorded time pair and explicit status enum
size/quantity bounds
packages.stop_condition: contract published; no slice written to a governed table
packages.authority_boundary: slices are derived artifacts; they carry no authority bit

packages.title: Aegis/Wind vocabulary consumption binding
evidence_outputs: Aegis registry component -> vocabulary kind mapping table
Wind workflow candidate consumption rule with provenance
explicit no-authority statement for both consumers
packages.authority_boundary: may not alter invariants, add transitions, or create an activation

packages.title: Keychains trigger-class -> event binding map
evidence_outputs: documented trigger-class table (resolution / peb / vision / legacy) next to TriggerEventContract
read-set and checkpoint binding rule per class
packages.stop_condition: mapping documented in place; projection code path unchanged (comment-only edit)
packages.authority_boundary: may not add a trigger class at runtime or change idempotency

packages.title: Resolution JSONB classification
evidence_outputs: one class per governed JSONB column (payload_only | queryable_identity | lineage | authority | projection)
governed-key preservation rule
temporal-semantics preservation rule
packages.stop_condition: classification published; no migration applied, no column altered
packages.rollback: supersede with a new classification version
packages.authority_boundary: may not promote payload to authority or move a governed key into JSONB-only storage

packages.title: KG projection contract freeze
evidence_outputs: ownership matrix for Resolution, Shrapnel, Aegis, Semantics, Keychains
frozen section / relation / provenance rule set referencing schemas/decision-b-freeze/relation-vocabulary-map.json
seed gate that must pass before any graph seeding
packages.stop_condition: freeze published; no seeding run, no graph rows written
packages.rollback: supersede the freeze file; no data to unwind
packages.authority_boundary: may not seed, and may not reassign a section or relation to a new owner

packages.title: Vision trigger-evidence registration
evidence_outputs: enumerated vision.lifecycle / vision.decision / vision.receipt trigger kinds with source paths
read_set and payload field expectations
known representation_disagreement rows cited as observed evidence
packages.stop_condition: emitter documented as evidence source only; no emitter code change
packages.authority_boundary: vision remains a satellite; no authority over work_request state

notes: Unfilled slots are reported, not back-filled. Closing them is child execution work.
Package IDs are stable; renames require a registry version bump.
